target: Truncated evidence must read UNVERIFIABLE, not explained: add TRUNCATED_EVIDENCE state in services/extracted_data_integrity.py and count it as failing in scripts/validate_control_source_values.py. Plus name the field that matched the fabrication marker.
findings_summary: Measured: exactly 23 rows have source_text of length 400, 13 of them is_current, across camden 6, cumberland 6, canada_bay 4, ryde 4, burwood 2, strathfield 1. Every one ends mid-word, so the 400 is a hard extractor limit, not a coincidence: a genuinely complete 400-char quote would end in punctuation, which is what separates the two. Confirmed the harm empirically both ways - cumberland 30 (rear 8m, CORRECT) was FALSELY FLAGGED because its evidence was severed, and cumberland 28 (front 6m, served) FALSELY PASSES because '6m' happened to survive inside the surviving window. Detection is length == 400 AND no terminal punctuation, applied at row level in explain_row since it is a property of the quote rather than of any one value. Treated as a failing state so the 23 enter the shrink-only baseline and any NEW truncated row blocks. This LOWERS the reported explained count, which is the honest direction. No schema change and no widening of source_text - migration 031 defines it as a citation snippet. No writes.
